visual_language.direction: black keynote theater stage, pure black canvas with white high-contrast type, one brand accent color per deck (single highlight span), one word or one giant number filling the frame, extreme negative space, presentation-zen restraint, tabular numerals

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以纯黑舞台、纯白高反差与一页只留一个品牌强调色的剧场纪律,做产品发布主题演讲与情绪向年度回顾;一屏一词或一个占满视野的巨型数字,大量负空间
legacy_payload.visual_direction: black keynote theater stage, pure black canvas with white high-contrast type, one brand accent color per deck (single highlight span), one word or one giant number filling the frame, extreme negative space, presentation-zen restraint, tabular numerals

canvas.background: 纯黑舞台场 #000000(纯黑非深蓝;板面即剧场黑场)
canvas.composition: 一屏一个主角:居中一行大字或巨型数字+单位+一行注;左右对比页用双栏(强调色 vs 灰)
canvas.density: low,极简到一屏一词——负空间是舞台灯光

color_palette.accent: #FF6900(品牌强调色示例:小米橙——每 deck 只选一个,高亮 span 专用)
color_palette.rule: 一 deck 一强调色,且只以高亮 span/条形高亮出场;黑白之外零彩色大面积;禁均匀深蓝底(GitHub-dark)+通用青紫霓虹 glow 的烂大街组合

typography.title: 几何无衬线超粗(思源黑体 Black / Inter Black),字距收紧,居中或左锚一行
typography.body: 同族常规字重,每页至多三行;数字 tabular-nums 等宽对齐
typography.labels: 小注一行(数字+单位+口径),灰级或强调色

layout_patterns: 标题页 = 黑底居中一行大字(+ 单个强调词高亮 span)
数据高潮页 = 巨型数字占满视野(clamp 超大)+ 单位 + 一行小注,别无他物
对比页 = 左右双栏参数对比:强调色条 vs 灰条(CSS Grid 两列)
slogan 页 = 单句宣言横贯,可加 hashtag 口号收尾
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 一屏一词/一数字,去产品照改纯文字反而更接近 Presentation Zen 本质;强调色全 deck 只用一个
negative_prompt: no uniform deep-blue GitHub-dark base (0D1117-style) with generic cyan-purple neon glow — the lazy combo
no multi-color accents; one brand accent per deck, highlight spans only
no crowded slides — the stage needs empty black room
no decorative particles or lens flares; the number is the light

visual_elements.allowed: 巨型数字与单位,单行大字,高亮 span,左右对比条,大负空间
visual_elements.avoid: 深蓝底霓虹;多彩强调;拥挤元素;粒子光效

rendering_constraints: Pure black stage, white type, exactly one brand accent color.
Giant numerals use tabular figures with tightened tracking.
